Answer: C
Reason: The CT images show a retrocardiac lesion in the left lower lobe containing an air-fluid level (cystic component) and surrounding hyperinflation/compensatory emphysema, which are characteristic features of intralobar pulmonary sequestration. The dilated azygos vein noted in Figure 3 likely represents systemic arterial supply or venous drainage associated with this congenital anomaly, distinguishing it from simple pneumonia or abscess.
